how: Vertical wind-tunnel indoor skydiving (simulated freefall, no jump) is listed in Shunyi district; the listing is undated so current operation is unconfirmed.
Shunyi Olympic Cable Park on the former 2008 Olympic rowing course has a 5-pylon Rixen cableway and hosts public watersports events and IWWF championships.

Beijing paragliding clubs (Super-Wing, Flying Man) run lessons and tandem flights, but flying sites such as Chaobaihe are about 1.5 hours from the Fourth Ring Road and airspace inside the city is restricted.
No whitewater within the metro area; river rafting runs in the hills at Pinggu (Lishugou) and Fangshan (Shidu), roughly 70-100 km and 1.5-2 hours from the centre.
Happy Gorilla Tree-Top Adventure Park in Chaoyang Park has graded high-rope circuits with nets, bridges and a final zipline, split by height.
Indoor ski simulators operate in malls (SkyTechSport installation at Wangfujing; Snow51 has expanded into Beijing); simulator slopes rather than snow.
Snorkelling is offered in aquarium tanks (Beijing Aquarium; Blue Zoo at Workers Stadium) and dive shops with training pools; no natural sea snorkelling nearby.
